snippet.title: Holy Shoot - Official Early Access Launch Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Holy Shoot is available now in Steam Early Access, and coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch. Holy Shoot is a fast-paced roguelite action FPS set in a satirical version of Hell, packed with chaos, blessed heroes, and demonic bosses. Pick your hero, dive into hell, upgrade your build, and shoot your way through sin. Watch the latest Holy Shoot trailer to see action-packed gameplay and more.
